strapiBlog.title: The Marble Palace: The Emirates Hills Mansion is Dubai’s Second Most Expensive Residential Sale
strapiBlog.short_description: Dubai’s luxury real estate market has kicked off 2025 with an extraordinary sale, further cementing the city's reputation as a global hotspot for ultra-premium properties.

data.text:
Dubai’s luxury real estate market has kicked off 2025 with an extraordinary sale, further cementing the city's reputation as a global hotspot for ultra-premium properties. The Marble Palace, an opulent Emirates Hills mansion, has officially been sold for a staggering AED 425 million! Let’s dive into the details of this record-breaking deal and explore what makes The Marble Palace a true architectural masterpiece.

What Makes Emirates Hills Mansion Unique?

Located in the prestigious Emirates Hills, a gated community known for its exclusivity and extravagant villas, The Marble Palace is nothing short of a masterpiece. Originally listed for AED 750 million, this property spans an impressive 60,000 square feet of interior space on a 70,000-square-foot plot. 

Inspired by the grandeur of Versailles, this palatial residence took nearly 12 years to construct, reaching completion in 2018. The attention to detail is exceptional, with AED 80 million to AED 100 million invested solely in the bespoke Italian stonework.

Features of Emirates Hills Mansion

The Marble Palace transcends the concept of a home—it is a masterpiece of indulgence and a testament to architectural brilliance. Some of the features that contributed to the record-breaking sale of Marble Palace include:

  • Five Lavish Bedrooms: Each bedroom is designed with meticulous detail and fitted with the finest materials.
  • Indoor and Outdoor Swimming Pools: These offer an unmatched luxury experience, perfect for relaxation and entertainment.
  • 70,000-Liter Coral Reef Aquarium: A stunning centerpiece that adds to the mansion’s grandeur.
  • Private Power Substation: Ensuring uninterrupted electricity supply, reinforcing the property’s exclusivity.
  • Fortified Emergency Rooms: Designed for maximum security and privacy.
    15-Car Garage: Ideal for car collectors and enthusiasts.

Think You’ve Seen It All? Think Again!

Dubai's most expensive residential sale records continue to be challenged as properties like The Marble Palace set new benchmarks.

Boasting architectural brilliance and a setting of sheer exclusivity, this transaction underscores how Emirates Hills is one of the highly sought-after destinations by ultra-wealthy buyers looking for unparalleled luxury.

faqs.question: What is the most expensive plot sold in Dubai?

data.answer: One of the most expensive plots ever sold in Dubai was on Jumeirah Bay Island, fetching AED 125 million.

faqs.question: What is the most expensive residential apartment in Dubai?

data.answer: The Sky Mansion at Bugatti Residences now holds the record as Dubai’s most expensive apartment, with a staggering price tag of AED 750 million.
Emirates Hills is renowned for its exclusivity, luxurious mansions, world-class amenities, and prime location near top business and leisure hubs in Dubai.

faqs.question: How long did it take to build The Marble Palace?

data.answer: The construction of The Marble Palace took nearly 12 years and was completed in 2018.

faqs.question: Who bought The Marble Palace in Emirates Hills?

data.answer:
The buyer’s identity has not been publicly disclosed, maintaining the high level of privacy that comes with such elite transactions.

The Marble Palace sale is yet another testament to Dubai’s booming luxury real estate market, setting the stage for even more record-breaking deals in the near future.
